scope: Exploratory frozen BVI VAL16; selector seeds0/1/2; one fixed E12 base seed0

bootstrap.protocol: Average each sequence's paired effect over three selector models, then shared whole-scene draws; total sums/counts
bootstrap.interval_scope: Conditional on these three fitted selectors, one base and their actual per-run candidate computations; unadjusted percentile95; no training-seed resampling or selection correction

candidate_repeatability: Fixed-average/initial-thirds metric drift is reported, not assumed zero. Candidates are shared within each run; cross-run changes are not attributable solely to selector initialization. Their numerical source is not isolated by this analysis.
